name: NetDragon Websoft Holdings Limited
summary: NetDragon Websoft Holdings Limited provides online and mobile games the People's Republic of China, the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, Spain, France, and internationally. It operates through the Gaming and Application Services, Mynd.ai Business, and Property Development segments. The company's games for kids include JumpStart, School of Dragons, Neopets, World of Madagascar, and Math Blaster; and other games comprise Eudemons Online, Conquer Online, Way of the Five, Conquer Online, and Heroes Evolved.
